subject: Channel partner entitlement & invoice cutover — go/no-go checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-09-29 10:05 -0700
Subject: Channel partner entitlement & invoice cutover — go/no-go checklist

Team,

We have a target cutover with Nimbus ResellCo to start channel-billed invoices for the CPPO bookings on Oct 5. Before we push the change we need a brief internal go/no-go to confirm: 

- Entitlement mapping: SKUs and marketplace SKUs mapped to Nimbus MSP accounts (attached entitlement-mapping-v1.csv).
- Invoice split: 70/30 billing flow confirmed and test invoice generated by finance.
- PO & procurement: Nimbus confirmed they will supply a single consolidated PO per month; need their PO template.
- Doc/signature: final contract addendum queued — DocuSign link will follow.
- Timeline: internal dry-run on Oct 3, production switch Oct 5, rollback window 24 hours.

Can Ben and Soojin own the test invoice and PO check respectively? Karthik, please confirm any integration blockers from marketplace listing side (SKU entitlements, pricebook IDs). I’ll loop in Nimbus once we have a short checklist ready.

Attaching: go-no-go-checklist.xlsx (draft), entitlement-mapping-v1.csv (WIP).

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Channel Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carlos Mendes <carlos.m@nimbusresell.com>
Date: 2027-09-29 15:40 -07:00
Subject: Re: Channel partner entitlement & invoice cutover — go/no-go checklist

Vanessa — thanks for the checklist. Quick updates from my side: 

- Finance will mock a test invoice by EOD Sep 30 and share the sample to Nimbus for acceptance. I’ll take point on that.
- I’ll request Nimbus’s PO template in this thread (cc-ed Carlos).
- For the dry-run, proposing we schedule a 45 min window on Oct 3 at 09:30 PT. That lets us exercise the marketplace entitlement flow and the billing split before the cutover.

Carlos — can you confirm Nimbus can run the test invoice acceptance on Oct 3 and share the PO template? Also flag any billing SOW or special tax handling we should be aware of.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Channel Partnerships
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Ben / Vanessa,

Thanks for the heads up. We can run the acceptance test on Oct 3 at 09:30 PT — the team is available. I’ve attached our PO template (Nimbus_PO_Template.pdf) to this reply for Redwood finance to confirm mapping to your invoice fields. Two notes from procurement: 

- Nimbus requires the invoice to include the marketplace SKU ID (msku) and Redwood invoice reference so reconciliation is automated on our side.
- For partner-billed transactions we need a consolidated invoice per entity per month; the 70/30 split is fine but ensure taxes are clear on the invoice line items.

We will also validate entitlement mappings during the dry run; please send the final mapping 24 hours prior so our entitlement engine can stage the rules.

Thanks Carlos — and great to hear Oct 3 works. Quick operational notes and next steps from ops side: 

1) Entitlement mapping: I’m attaching a refreshed entitlement CSV (entitlement-mapping-v1.csv) with the marketplace msku column populated. Please confirm that the msku column matches Nimbus’s catalog IDs.

2) Invoice fields: Redwood finance needs to include these additional fields on the invoice lines — marketplace_msku, partner_reference, tax_code. I’ll share the sample invoice by EOD Sep 30 (Ben is owning).

3) PO acceptance: Carlos/procurement, once we receive your PO template we’ll validate fields and reply with any required field remaps within 24 hours.

4) Dry-run agenda (Oct 3, 09:30 PT, 45m):
   - 09:30: Kickoff and roles (Ben/Vanessa/Carlos)
   - 09:35: Entitlement staging validation (Soojin/Karthik/Nimbus tech)
   - 09:50: Test invoice generation & ingestion check (Ben/Finance/Nimbus procurement)
   - 10:05: Reconciliation smoke test and go/no-go decision

If there are no blockers I’ll schedule the meeting and include a shared test dataset and the DocuSign addendum draft.

Regards,
Soojin Lee
Marketplace Operations
Redwood Inference
